gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Friendly and funky, Groovy leaves only a thin slit in its c. Noto Sans Adlam keeps its curve endings well apart, with lowercase c, s and z that stand full and generous beside it.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-anatolian: Loose, bouncy and a bit retro, Groovy draws its arms and legs at constant width, almost closing the c. Noto Sans Anatolian Hieroglyphs opens right up beside it.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-arabic: Funky and friendly, Groovy draws every line with flat, unmodulated weight, almost sealing its c into a slit. Noto Sans Arabic handles the reading, with wide openings on small letters.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-avestan: Noto Sans Avestan reads modern and clean, its curve tips stopping short of touching, with a pronounced x-height. And Groovy brings the funk up top, joins as thick as its strokes, while the body sans does the quiet work.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-bassa-vah: Noto Sans Bassa Vah reads professional and contemporary, its dominant midsection swallowing most of the line's height. Noto Sans Bassa Vah's open-jawed c keeps a long passage moving smoothly, never cramped, under Groovy's round, constant-walled bowls.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-batak: Noto Sans Batak has an x-height towering like a stubby carpenter's pencil stroke, with a wide-open e that never looks squeezed. Groovy earns its keep big and short.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-bengali: Groovy is friendly, funky and loosely spaced, with a narrow slit in its c. Noto Sans Bengali sits below with capitals barely taller than lowercase and distinctly open letter mouths, which keeps a long passage easy on the eye.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-cham: Marker-nib swagger, that's Groovy, a line that ignores direction and nearly closes its c. Noto Sans Cham follows with open, rounded lowercase and plenty of entry space, a smooth read.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-cherokee: Noto Sans Cherokee reads approachable, with a high band of letters and an e that leaves a wide gap at its terminal. Groovy is best at loud, funky display with no calligraphic shading, while the body font settles into steady reading.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-coptic: Slim joins, loose spacing and a nearly shut c give Groovy a pipe-cleaner funk. Noto Sans Coptic is best at texture, its middle zone dominating the line and its s and c uncrowded.
